subject: Stepped concurrency & token distribution — pre-sales probe
messages:
From: Ellie Chan <ellie@clearpath.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@clearpath.ai
Date: Mon, 08 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated sizing — preliminary traffic snapshot attached

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this on. Attaching a compact traffic snapshot (clearpath_traffic_snapshot.csv) — it includes a two-week sample with timestamps, session ids, prompt/response token counts and a coarse classification (chat vs. single-shot). High level:
- Typical daily peak: stepped ramp from ~5 concurrent sessions at 06:00 PDT up to ~50 by 11:00, plateau to 16:00, then taper down.
- Prompt tokens: median ~38, mean ~47; response tokens: median ~90, mean ~120.
- Approximately 18% of requests use streaming; ~7% include function/tool calls.
- We care about p95 latency ~500ms (soft), p99 < 1.2s (hard).

We are evaluating a dedicated pool for predictable latency and a canary path for new model variants. Can you confirm what additional fields you need to produce a fleet-sizing sketch (GPU mix, burst allowance, canary capacity)? Also attaching our ops alias for any onboarding/infra questions.

Appreciate a short list of clarifying Qs so we can get this back to procurement.

Thanks,
Ellie Chan
Director, Platform & Integrations
ClearPath AI

Attachments: clearpath_traffic_snapshot.csv (csv)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Chan <ellie@clearpath.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 08 Jul 2029 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated sizing — preliminary traffic snapshot attached

Hi Ellie — thanks for the quick snapshot, this is exactly the sort of data we need to start a preliminary sizing. A few targeted asks that help us convert this into a dedicated-fleet sketch and a canary fallback plan: 1) Concurrency windows: can you provide the 5/50/95/99th concurrency points by hour (CSV column names: hour, conc_p5, conc_p50, conc_p95, conc_p99)? 2) Session stickiness: what fraction of sessions issue multiple requests within 60s (we call these short-session multimessages) vs single-shot? 3) Streaming specifics: for the ~18% streaming workload — is the token emission steady or bursty? Any average stream duration? 4) Function/tool calling: what proportion of those calls incur additional model tokens (e.g., tool-augmented responses)? 5) Model variants and canary policy: do you want a 5% traffic canary or do you prefer request-level routing by region/time? 6) SLA and fallback tolerance: what p99 latency we must honor during a cross-region failover? 7) Retention / KV cache: do you want prefix caching across sessions (helps reduce cost for repeated prompts)? 8) Any regulatory constraints (EU residency, on-prem token logs)?

If it's easier, fill the attached one-page template and we can walk a 30-min call. I dropped a preliminary mapping (proposed_map_v1.pdf) that sketches a 3-GPU pool hypothesis (1x A100-class for peak, 2x H100-class for parallel throughput) with a 10% canary reserve. It's intentionally conservative until we get the conc p95/p99 hour slices.

Would Marissa or Karthik like to join the next sync to talk quantization and autoscaling policy?

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer — Dedicated Capacity
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_map_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Chan <ellie@clearpath.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Jul 2029 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated sizing — follow-ups on streaming and burst behavior

Quick follow-ups from infra sizing perspective:
- Do any requests include images or multimodal payloads (even low-res thumbnails)? If yes, percentage and average image size.
- For streaming: is client-side latency sensitivity driving small chunk sizes (e.g., 64 tokens/chunk) or larger frames?
- Are you planning scheduled daily batch workloads (off-peak heavy batch runs) that would change sustained throughput needs?
- Encryption & KMS: confirm if ClearPath will bring its own KMS or use Redwood-managed keys (this affects Private deployment sizing and network egress planning).

If you can drop short answers in-line we can fold into the sizing sketch this afternoon.

Thanks — Marissa
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Ellie Chan <ellie@clearpath.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Jul 2029 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated sizing — preliminary traffic snapshot attached

Thanks all — quick answers inline below. Apologies for the terse format, wanted to get this back to you before procurement review: 

On Mon, Jul 8, 2029 at 11:04 AM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai> wrote:
> 1) Concurrency windows: can you provide the 5/50/95/99th concurrency points by hour?
We exported the per-hour conc p5/p50/p95/p99; see the CSV column "hour_concurrency_breakdown" in the attached file (clearpath_traffic_snapshot.csv). If you prefer, we can paste the top-of-day hours as a CSV row.

> 2) Session stickiness: what fraction of sessions issue multiple requests within 60s?
Roughly 42% are multimessage within 60s; the rest are single-shot.

> 3) Streaming specifics: is the token emission steady or bursty? Average stream duration?
Streaming emission is mostly steady for chat agents (avg stream duration ~1.8s, median chunks ~64 tokens). Video-augmented streams (rare) can be burstier but are <1% of total.

> 4) Function/tool calling: what proportion of those calls incur additional model tokens?
~60% of function calls trigger an extra model request to synthesize results — add ~80 tokens on average.

> 5) Model variants and canary policy: do you want a 5% traffic canary or request-level routing by region/time?
We prefer a time-windowed 5% canary first (US-west morning traffic) with automatic rollback on regression.

> 6) SLA and fallback tolerance: what p99 latency we must honor during a cross-region failover?
Aim to preserve p99 < 1.5s in failover mode; production tight target is p99 < 1.2s.

> 7) Retention / KV cache: do you want prefix caching across sessions?
Yes — prefix caching for repeated prompts would be valuable; we expect ~12% token reduction if enabled.

> 8) Any regulatory constraints?
No EU residency requirement for this initial deployment; US-only for now.

On Mon, Jul 8, 2029 at 01:20 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Do any requests include images or multimodal payloads?
There are occasional thumbnails (~2% of traffic) at ~80KB average. No heavy multimodal vectors in this phase.

> For streaming: is client-side latency sensitivity driving small chunk sizes?
Yes — average chunk size ~64 tokens as noted above.

> Scheduled batch workloads?
We have an hourly batch job that re-processes failed items; it's lightweight (equivalent to ~3% sustained extra throughput during 02:00-03:00 PDT).

> Encryption & KMS: will you bring your own?
ClearPath will use Redwood-managed keys for the pilot; we may transition to BYOK on commit.

We'll fill the template later today and are available for a 30-min sync at 14:00 PDT if that works for your team.

— Ellie
Director, Platform & Integrations, ClearPath AI

Attachments: clearpath_traffic_snapshot.csv (csv)
